key_insight: Neural transfer unification (NTU) lets a foundation decoder learn decoding structure on smaller quantum codes and transfer that knowledge to larger code distances efficiently.
engineering_relevance: This offers a scalable path to fault-tolerant quantum decoding, reducing the training and syndrome-generation burden as code size grows.
method: Align decoding tasks across code distances using algebraic structure shared by scalable code families.
Use a transformer-based decoder (NTU-Transformer) for planar surface codes and bivariate bicycle codes.
Transfer learned decoding knowledge from smaller codes to accelerate optimization on larger codes.
evidence_signal: In the abstract, NTU-Transformer outperforms correlation-aware matching on the [![361,1,19]!] planar surface code, scales to [![625,1,25]!] with transfer adaptation, and beats Relay-BP on the [![72,12,6]!] bivariate bicycle code at low physical error rates.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on code-family structure and transfer setup, so generalization to other codes or noise models may require additional adaptation and evaluation.
paper_title: Efficient foundation decoders for fault-tolerant quantum computing
